item.title: Bend Awards $100,000 to Support Immigrant Families Amid Federal Crackdown - The Source - Bend, Oregon
item.description: The Bend City Council denounced the Trump administration’s mass deportation effort and awarded a nonprofit $100,000 to help families affected by the immigration crackdown. The move came in response to calls for support by the Latino Community Association, a Central Oregon nonprofit providing support services for immigrants.
